description: This file defines a SwiftUI View called AboutSettings, which displays application information, links, and updater controls for the OpenClaw macOS app. It also includes related subviews and preview configuration.

classes.name: AboutSettings
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that presents app info, links, and updater controls.

classes.name: AboutLinkRow
classes.description: A subview representing a clickable link row with icon for external URLs.

classes.name: AboutMetaRow
classes.description: A subview displaying a label-value pair, styled for metadata display.

methods.name: versionString
methods.description: Constructs a version string from app bundle info.

methods.name: buildTimestamp
methods.description: Parses and formats the build timestamp from bundle info.

methods.name: gitCommit
methods.description: Retrieves the Git commit hash from bundle info.

methods.name: buildSuffix
methods.description: Creates a suffix string including the git commit and debug flag.
